role: The item-use action kind Item.getItemUseAction returns: none, eat, drink, block, bow; it decides the eating flow, sword blocking and bow drawing.

members.name: none, eat, drink, block, bow (5 constants)
members.note: No enum object: getItemUseAction's answers live where each use runs (surv_item_use_duration: food, milk and potions 32, the sword's block and the bow 72000; the eat and drink finishes in surv_server_eat_tick, the particles and sounds of eat against drink by item). Every vanilla item that has an action is covered; the drink is use-kinds-s1's milk and potions.

notes: lane/idxblocks: the drink action (milk, fire resistance and instant health potions) replays in use-kinds-s1.
